findings.description: confirmed false claim: AVEVA PDMS RVM format registration — core geometry import/export works
findings.quote: AVEVA PDMS RVM format registration — core geometry import/export works
findings.truth: No RVM importer or exporter exists: IOService registers only OBJ, STL, glTF, FBX, 3MF, COLLADA, PLY and 3DS readers/writers, RvmFormat is not in the FileFormat registry, and RvmFormat only exposes LoadAttributes which throws.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `.dae`, and `.3mf` files through `Scene.Open`, `Scene.FromFile`, `Scene.Save`, and `Scene.
findings.quote: `.dae`, and `.3mf` files through `Scene.Open`, `Scene.FromFile`, `Scene.Save`, and `Scene.FromStream` with full round-trip fidelity
findings.truth: Stream-based Scene.Open/FromStream maps only Obj/Stl/Gltf/Fbx/Ply/3ds load options to a format and throws NotSupportedException for the BasicLoadOptions used by .dae and .3mf, so FromStream cannot load COLLADA or 3MF; nothing in the source or tests establishes 'full round-trip fidelity' (no animation, skinning or morph data is read or written by any reader/writer).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `Chunk` | Represents a 3DS chunk header. |
findings.quote: `Chunk` | Represents a 3DS chunk header. |
findings.truth: Chunk is a struct nested inside the internal static class ChunkHelper, so it is not part of the public API.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `NurbsSurface.ToMesh` throw `NotImplementedException`
findings.quote: `NurbsSurface.ToMesh` throw `NotImplementedException`
findings.truth: NurbsSurface.ToMesh does not throw; it returns a placeholder flat grid mesh without evaluating the NURBS basis (code comments say 'Simple linear interpolation for now').

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `Property-GLTF` | Exposes `GetExtra`/`SetExtra` for arbitrary user data and `GetBindPoint`
findings.quote: `Property-GLTF` | Exposes `GetExtra`/`SetExtra` for arbitrary user data and `GetBindPoint` for animation bind points.
findings.truth: Aspose.ThreeD.Formats.GLTF.StructuralMetadata.Property has only Name, DisplayName, Description, Type, EnumType, Normalized, Count and a throwing ToString; GetExtra/SetExtra/GetBindPoint belong to Aspose.ThreeD.Property (descriptions are swapped).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `PropertyTable` | A table of `PropertyCollection` entries indexed by name.
findings.quote: `PropertyTable` | A table of `PropertyCollection` entries indexed by name.
findings.truth: GLTF PropertyTable holds Name, MetaClass (ClassType) and a Dictionary<string, object> Values; it has no PropertyCollection entries, and its GetValue/AddValue throw NotImplementedException.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `Scene.Render`, `RenderFactory`, and the `IRenderTarget`/`IRenderWindow` rendering pipelin
findings.quote: `Scene.Render`, `RenderFactory`, and the `IRenderTarget`/`IRenderWindow` rendering pipeline all throw `NotImplementedException`
findings.truth: Only Scene.Render throws; RenderFactory is an abstract class whose virtual Create* methods return null (no throw statements), and IRenderTarget/IRenderWindow are interfaces with no implementation that could throw.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `VertexElementTangent` | Per-vertex tangent data, exposed via `Tangents`.
findings.quote: `VertexElementTangent` | Per-vertex tangent data, exposed via `Tangents`.
findings.truth: No member named Tangents exists anywhere in the source; VertexElementTangent derives from VertexElementFVector and exposes its data through the inherited Data/SetData members.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: per-format static members (`WavefrontOBJ`, `STLBinary`, `GLTF2`, `Collada`, `Discreet3DS`,
findings.quote: per-format static members (`WavefrontOBJ`, `STLBinary`, `GLTF2`, `Collada`, `Discreet3DS`, `Microsoft3MF`) used with `Scene.Save()`/`FromFile()`
findings.truth: Of these, only FileFormat.Discreet3DS (aliased to the internal registered Discreet3DSFormat) overrides CreateLoadOptions/CreateSaveOptions; WavefrontOBJ, STLBinary, GLTF2, Collada and Microsoft3MF (Formats.Microsoft3MFFormat, no override) throw NotImplementedException when passed to Scene.Save(path, format) or Scene.FromFile(path, format, token).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: scene.Save("output.fbx", FileFormat.FBX7400Binary);
findings.quote: scene.Save("output.fbx", FileFormat.FBX7400Binary);
findings.truth: Scene.Save(string, FileFormat) calls format.CreateSaveOptions(); FileFormat.FBX7400Binary is a plain FileFormat instance whose CreateSaveOptions is the base virtual that throws NotImplementedException, so the first Quick Start example throws at runtime (only the internal registry formats, or explicit options such as new FbxSaveOptions(FileFormat.FBX7700Binary), work).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: scene.Save("output.obj", FileFormat.WavefrontOBJ);
findings.quote: scene.Save("output.obj", FileFormat.WavefrontOBJ);
findings.truth: FileFormat.WavefrontOBJ is a base FileFormat whose CreateSaveOptions throws NotImplementedException, so Save(path, FileFormat.WavefrontOBJ) throws; the repo's own test only asserts that this call throws an exception; scene.Save("output.obj") (extension-based) would work.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: **[Release 26.2.0 notes](docs/release-26.2.0.md)** — change log for this release
findings.quote: **[Release 26.2.0 notes](docs/release-26.2.0.md)** — change log for this release
findings.truth: The only released package and the csproj version are 26.1.0; the 26.2.0 notes describe an unreleased version (and state Target Framework .NET 10.0 only).

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: The product handles skeletal animation with bones, keyframes, and morph targets
findings.quote: The product handles skeletal animation with bones, keyframes, and morph targets
findings.truth: Bone/SkinDeformer/MorphTargetDeformer/AnimationClip exist only as in-memory object model classes; no importer or exporter under Formats reads or writes animation, skin or morph-target data (grep of Formats/*Reader.cs and *Writer.cs finds no animation/deformer/skin references).

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `AGENTS.md` outlines the project's contribution guidelines and expectations for community
findings.quote: `AGENTS.md` outlines the project's contribution guidelines and expectations for community participants.
findings.truth: AGENTS.md is titled 'AI Agent Guide' and contains the implementation strategy, API classification and implementation status, not community contribution guidelines.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `GlobalTransform` | The immutable final evaluated transformation, similar to `Transform` b
findings.quote: `GlobalTransform` | The immutable final evaluated transformation, similar to `Transform` but read-only.
findings.truth: GlobalTransform is a stub: Translation returns Vector3.Zero, Scale Vector3.One, EulerAngles Zero, Rotation Quaternion.Identity and TransformMatrix Matrix4.Identity regardless of the node.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `Html5SaveOptions` | Save options for HTML5 (Aspose 3D Web viewer) export.
findings.quote: `Html5SaveOptions` | Save options for HTML5 (Aspose 3D Web viewer) export.
findings.truth: No HTML5 exporter exists (IOService has no HTML/AMF/U3D/Draco/PDF exporter and Scene.Save(stream, options) rejects these option types with NotSupportedException), so these options cannot be used to export anything.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `Text` watermarking is not currently functional
findings.quote: `Text` watermarking is not currently functional
findings.truth: Text is a font/text profile with no watermark members; the stubbed watermark API is the separate static class Aspose.ThreeD.Utilities.Watermark, whose EncodeWatermark/DecodeWatermark throw NotImplementedException.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `Version`: Version of the Aspose.3D library.
findings.quote: `Version`: Version of the Aspose.3D library.
findings.truth: Scene.Version is the constant string "FOSS", not a library version number (the package version is 26.1.0).

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: their equivalents for FBX, glTF, STL, and 3MF
findings.quote: their equivalents for FBX, glTF, STL, and 3MF
findings.truth: 3MF has only Microsoft3MFSaveOptions (no 3MF load options type; 3MF and COLLADA load with an internal BasicLoadOptions), and there is no ColladaLoadOptions either.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python reads and writes OBJ, STL, glTF, and COLLADA files
findings.quote: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python reads and writes OBJ, STL, glTF, and COLLADA files
findings.truth: COLLADA and OBJ cannot be written via Scene.save() (the README's own bullet below admits COLLADA export is unreachable); 3MF, which does round-trip, is omitted.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Cap2["Export to common 3D formats"] --> Output["3MF, COLLADA, GLB, glTF, OBJ, or STL file"
findings.quote: Cap2["Export to common 3D formats"] --> Output["3MF, COLLADA, GLB, glTF, OBJ, or STL file"]
findings.truth: Neither COLLADA (.dae) nor OBJ can be written through Scene.save() at this revision (NotImplementedError for .dae; TypeError for a .obj filename, empty output for a stream).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: It exports scenes to `.3mf`, `.dae`, `.glb`, `.gltf`, `.obj`, and `.stl` formats using `Sc
findings.quote: It exports scenes to `.3mf`, `.dae`, `.glb`, `.gltf`, `.obj`, and `.stl` formats using `Scene.save()`
findings.truth: Scene.save() cannot produce .dae (exporter lookup hits FbxExporter's unimplemented supports_format and raises NotImplementedError) and cannot produce a usable .obj: a filename save opens the file 'wb' and ObjExporter writes a str (TypeError), and even a text-stream save writes nothing because _collect_nodes stops at the entity-less root node.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Material class lets you manage texture maps and custom properties, supporting specular, di
findings.quote: Material class lets you manage texture maps and custom properties, supporting specular, diffuse, emissive, ambient, and normal maps.
findings.truth: Material.get_texture and Material.set_texture both raise NotImplementedError, and Texture/TextureBase cannot be constructed, so no texture maps can be managed.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Triangulate arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans
findings.quote: Triangulate arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans
findings.truth: PolygonModifier triangulates by ear clipping and only falls back to a fan when no ear is found; the next clause of the same bullet says it is not a naive fan split.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: WeightedMode enum values NONE, OUT_WEIGHT, NEXT_IN_WEIGHT, and BOTH let developers specify
findings.quote: WeightedMode enum values NONE, OUT_WEIGHT, NEXT_IN_WEIGHT, and BOTH let developers specify how vertex weights are applied during mesh processing.
findings.truth: WeightedMode is the keyframe tangent-weight mode used by KeyFrame.tangent_weight_mode in the animation module; it has nothing to do with vertex weights or mesh processing.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `Scene.open()`/`Scene.save()` cannot detect or dispatch any of these extensions, and raise
findings.quote: `Scene.open()`/`Scene.save()` cannot detect or dispatch any of these extensions, and raise a `RuntimeError` if you try
findings.truth: Scene.open() raises RuntimeError for these extensions, but Scene.save() raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'create_save_options') because get_format_by_extension returns None.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: utilities for scene construction, entity management, and rendering
findings.quote: utilities for scene construction, entity management, and rendering
findings.truth: Rendering is not implemented: Scene.render raises NotImplementedError and Renderer/RenderFactory/Viewport raise on construction (the README's own Scope section says the library does not render).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: with automatic format detection from the file extension or an explicit `FileFormat` argume
findings.quote: with automatic format detection from the file extension or an explicit `FileFormat` argument
findings.truth: Scene.open(file, options) always detects the format from the extension for filenames (or detectors for streams); a non-LoadOptions second argument such as a FileFormat is discarded and replaced by detected_format.create_load_options().

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: ImageRenderOptions lets you configure rendering parameters such as background_color, enabl
findings.quote: ImageRenderOptions lets you configure rendering parameters such as background_color, enable_shadows, and asset_directories before passing the options to a renderer.
findings.truth: No renderer exists to pass the options to: Scene.render and Renderer raise NotImplementedError.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: Records one bone's world and local transform matrices inside a `Pose`
findings.quote: Records one bone's world and local transform matrices inside a `Pose`
findings.truth: BonePose holds a single `matrix` plus an `is_local` flag, not separate world and local matrices.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: The PyPI packaging readiness document confirms that Aspose.3D FOSS for Python meets the re
findings.quote: The PyPI packaging readiness document confirms that Aspose.3D FOSS for Python meets the requirements for distribution on PyPI.
findings.truth: docs/PYPI_READINESS.md is a stale checklist about a package named `aspose-3d` with an examples/ directory that does not exist at this revision.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: The test suite, located in the tests/ directory, uses the standard-library unittest framew
findings.quote: The test suite, located in the tests/ directory, uses the standard-library unittest framework
findings.truth: Only 24 of the 34 files in tests/ use unittest; others such as test_fbx_simple.py, test_imports.py, test_mesh.py and test_polygon_modifier.py are plain scripts/pytest-style functions, and `unittest discover tests/` reports 5 errors from missing examples/ fixture files.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: This is raised in Scene.Open/Scene.Save when no licenses are applied.
findings.quote: This is raised in Scene.Open/Scene.Save when no licenses are applied.
findings.truth: Nothing in the package raises TrialException; there is no licensing in this FOSS build (the class is only defined and exported). Appears in both API tables.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: exposes translation, scale, euler_angles, rotation, and transform_matrix properties for di
findings.quote: exposes translation, scale, euler_angles, rotation, and transform_matrix properties for direct manipulation
findings.truth: All five GlobalTransform properties are read-only getters (no setters); the world transform cannot be manipulated through it.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: optional `Mesh`-derived `Entity`, and materials
findings.quote: optional `Mesh`-derived `Entity`, and materials
findings.truth: Node entities are Entity subclasses (Camera, Light, Curve, Mesh...), not Mesh-derived; the same false relation as the API Reference intro, printed a second time in the detailed member reference.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: optional `Mesh`-derived entities, and materials
findings.quote: optional `Mesh`-derived entities, and materials
findings.truth: Node entities are Entity subclasses (Camera, Light, Curve, Mesh...), not Mesh-derived.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: the entire `aspose.threed.render` module (`Renderer`, `RenderFactory`, `Viewport`, and rel
findings.quote: the entire `aspose.threed.render` module (`Renderer`, `RenderFactory`, `Viewport`, and related classes) raise `NotImplementedError`
findings.truth: Renderer, RenderFactory and Viewport do raise, but 18 of the 60 render modules (e.g. BlendFactor, CompareFunction, PixelFormat enum holders and the exception classes) contain no NotImplementedError at all.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - `Borders`: Gets or sets border settings.
findings.quote: - `Borders`: Gets or sets border settings.
findings.truth: Style.Borders has a private setter (`public Borders Borders { get; private set; }`), so it is get-only for callers; mutate the returned Borders instead.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - `Font`: Gets or sets the font settings.
findings.quote: - `Font`: Gets or sets the font settings.
findings.truth: Style.Font has a private setter (`public Font Font { get; private set; }`); it is get-only for callers.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET provides core workbook and worksheet functionality through the
findings.quote: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET provides core workbook and worksheet functionality through the `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Workbook` class, which exposes collections for worksheets, defined names, and charts, and supports loading, saving, and protection operations.
findings.truth: Workbook exposes only Worksheets, DefinedNames, Settings, Properties, DocumentProperties and LoadDiagnostics; charts live on Worksheet.Charts and workbook protection is reached via Workbook.Properties.Protection, not Workbook methods.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: The `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.SaveFormat` class specifies output formats for saving a workbook, i
findings.quote: The `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.SaveFormat` class specifies output formats for saving a workbook, including PDF via `PdfSaveOptions` and other save formats through `SaveOptions`.
findings.truth: SaveFormat is an enum (not a class) with only two members, Xlsx and Pdf; there are no other save formats.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: The `Style` class enables formatting of cells through properties such as `Font`, `Color`,
findings.quote: The `Style` class enables formatting of cells through properties such as `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Border`
findings.truth: Style has no Color, FillPattern or Border property; its properties are Font, Borders, Pattern (of type FillPattern), ForegroundColor and BackgroundColor.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: - `Save`: Saves the workbook to an XLSX file using default save options.
findings.quote: - `Save`: Saves the workbook to an XLSX file using default save options.
findings.truth: Workbook.Save(string) switches to SaveFormat.Pdf when the file name ends in .pdf, and there are four more Save overloads (SaveFormat/SaveOptions, file or Stream), so it does not always write XLSX.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: It runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and does not require Microsoft Excel or any native O
findings.evidence: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/skiasharp/2.88.8/skiasharp.nuspec dependencies group net6.0 (only NativeAssets.Win32 + NativeAssets.macOS); https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.cells.foss/26.10.0/aspose.cells.foss.nuspec dependencies (SkiaSharp only); src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj:53-54@f71fe5595ebdaf16e2e0a7d7c8224f399b54c4e2; src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj:54@f71fe5595ebdaf16e2e0a7d7c8224f399b54c4e2 (SkiaSharp 2.88.8)
findings.quote: It runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and does not require Microsoft Excel or any native Office installation.
findings.truth: Aspose.Cells.FOSS depends on SkiaSharp 2.88.8 for PDF rendering, and SkiaSharp 2.88.8 pulls native libSkiaSharp assets only for Win32 and macOS; PDF export on Linux needs SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux, which the package does not declare, so the Linux / no-native-installation statement is unqualified.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Style`, `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Border` classes
findings.quote: `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Style`, `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Border` classes
findings.truth: Color is a struct and FillPattern is an enum, not classes.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: classes to organize and sort worksheet content
findings.quote: classes to organize and sort worksheet content
findings.truth: AutoFilterSortState and AutoFilterSortCondition only store sort-state metadata (Ref, Descending, SortBy, CustomList). No method sorts or reorders cell data, and FilterColumn does not hide rows.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: example projects demonstrating how to use `Aspose.Cells.FOSS` version 26.10.0
findings.quote: example projects demonstrating how to use `Aspose.Cells.FOSS` version 26.10.0
findings.truth: All 15 sample projects use a ProjectReference to the in-repo source project, not the published 26.10.0 NuGet package.

findings.description: confirmed misleading claim: reads Excel files and writes Excel and PDF files
findings.quote: reads Excel files and writes Excel and PDF files
findings.truth: Only .xlsx is supported: LoadFormat has only Auto and Xlsx, and SaveFormat has only Xlsx and Pdf. 'Excel files' suggests .xls, .xlsb and .xlsm too, which the README's own Scope section rules out.

findings.description: confirmed unsupported claim: outlines how to contribute code, report issues, and interact with
findings.evidence: agents.md:5@f71fe5595ebdaf16e2e0a7d7c8224f399b54c4e2 (no 'contribut' or 'issue' text anywhere in its 168 lines)
findings.quote: outlines how to contribute code, report issues, and interact with
findings.truth: agents.md says it 'defines how agents should work in this checkout'. It covers agent working rules and has no contribution workflow or issue-reporting guidance.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - **Read and write cell values and formulas.** It writes values of multiple types—includin
findings.quote: - **Read and write cell values and formulas.** It writes values of multiple types—including strings, integers, doubles, and booleans—via `Cell.PutValue`, retrieves them as a variant-typed `CellValue`, and sets or reads formulas with `Cell.SetFormula` and `Cell.GetFormula`, throwing `FormulaException` for invalid formulas.
findings.truth: Cell::SetFormula (Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/src/aspose/cells_foss/Cell.cpp:153) only normalizes and stores the text, and FormulaException is never thrown anywhere in src (only defined in FormulaException.cpp:6).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - Only `.xlsx` (OOXML) is supported for load and save. `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each
findings.quote: - Only `.xlsx` (OOXML) is supported for load and save. `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each declare a single Xlsx member, and saving to any other format throws `UnsupportedFeatureException`. There is no .xls, .xlsb, .ods, or .csv read/write support. Legacy `SpreadsheetML` is not implemented. `Cell`-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object. Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are recognized on load but not preserved. `AutoFilter` date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.
findings.truth: include/aspose/cells_foss/LoadFormat.h:7-13 declares Auto=0 and Xlsx=1, so 'LoadFormat and SaveFormat each declare a single Xlsx member' is wrong (only SaveFormat.h:7-11 has one member).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp reads and writes Excel files in the `.xlsx` format. It provides
findings.quote: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp reads and writes Excel files in the `.xlsx` format. It provides classes such as `Workbook`, `Worksheet`, and `Cell` to create, modify, and save spreadsheets programmatically. The product supports styling with `Style`, `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Borders`, and includes features like formula calculation, validation, hyperlinks, and page setup. It is implemented in C++ using C++17 and requires CMake 3.16 or later.
findings.truth: No formula evaluator exists in the source (only CalculationProperties settings and a number-format EvaluateCondition at DisplayTextFormatterSupport.cpp:345); Cell.cpp:153 SetFormula just stores text, so 'formula calculation' is ungrounded.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `FormulaException` / `StyleException` — invalid formula text or style value
findings.quote: `FormulaException` / `StyleException` — invalid formula text or style value
findings.truth: Neither exception is thrown by any library code; only their constructors are defined.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each declare a single Xlsx member
findings.quote: `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each declare a single Xlsx member
findings.truth: LoadFormat declares two members, Auto = 0 and Xlsx = 1 (only SaveFormat has the single Xlsx member).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: full public surface — 195 public types — is listed below, grouped exactly as
findings.quote: full public surface — 195 public types — is listed below, grouped exactly as
findings.truth: The table that follows (lines 646-803) lists only 157 rows; the 195 figure matches the earlier Core API table (168 classes + 27 enums).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: includes features like formula calculation
findings.quote: includes features like formula calculation
findings.truth: Formulas are stored as text only; there is no formula evaluation or calculation engine (only CalculationProperties metadata is read/written).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: throwing `FormulaException` for invalid formulas
findings.quote: throwing `FormulaException` for invalid formulas
findings.truth: Cell::SetFormula only strips a leading '=' and stores the text; FormulaException is defined but never thrown anywhere in the library.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Runnable programs for every capability live under `examples/`
findings.quote: Runnable programs for every capability live under `examples/`
findings.truth: No example covers password encryption (SetPassword is not used anywhere under examples/), nor charts, pivot tables or conditional formatting.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: The suite covers 22 test files under `tests/`
findings.quote: The suite covers 22 test files under `tests/`

findings.quote: `CalculateFormula` supports only SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN; any other formula returns an error
findings.truth: CalculateFormula also evaluates COUNT, CONCAT, IF, COUNTIF, VLOOKUP, ROUND, ABS, POWER, SQRT, LEN, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, UPPER, LOWER, AND, OR, NOT; only unknown names error.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: provides formula calculation for SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN
findings.quote: provides formula calculation for SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN
findings.truth: The engine supports about 19 functions, not just these four.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: reference for all 14 public types (the [API reference](#api-reference) section above cover
findings.quote: reference for all 14 public types (the [API reference](#api-reference) section above covers the
findings.truth: README line 337 says the verified public surface has 28 types; aspose/cells_foss declares 28 exported types@99c789e9175f2b12ad82bafeeba148ddcc1367fb.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: controls workbook and worksheet protection with separate passwords for structure, windows,
findings.quote: controls workbook and worksheet protection with separate passwords for structure, windows, and revisions
findings.truth: WorkbookProtection has boolean lock flags for structure/windows/revision but only two passwords (setWorkbookPassword and setRevisionsPassword); there is no windows password.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: mvn javadoc:javadoc   # generates docs/apidocs/index.html
findings.quote: mvn javadoc:javadoc   # generates docs/apidocs/index.html
findings.truth: The plugin outputDirectory is ${project.build.directory}/apidocs (target/apidocs); the committed docs/apidocs is stale (com/aspose/cells_foss paths, not org.aspose) and is not regenerated by this command.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - **Format cells and ranges.** It applies styles to cells and ranges using the `Style`, `F
findings.quote: - **Format cells and ranges.** It applies styles to cells and ranges using the `Style`, `Font`, `RichTextRun`, `FillType`, and `TextAlignmentType` objects to set bold, color, size, fill, and alignment properties.
findings.truth: FillType and TextAlignmentType are drawing-shape enums (ECMA a:spPr / a:pPr); cell fill and alignment use Style.set_fill_color/set_horizontal_alignment (string values) and the Fill/Alignment classes, not these enums.

findings.quote: The package declares `python_requires` as `>=3.10`
findings.truth: pyproject.toml declares requires-python = ">=3.10"; there is no python_requires key and no setup.py.

findings.quote: `python_requires=">=3.10"` in `pyproject.toml`
findings.truth: The key in pyproject.toml is requires-python, not python_requires.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: style.font.color = "#FF0000"
findings.quote: style.font.color = "#FF0000"
findings.truth: Font.color is documented as AARRGGBB hex (e.g. 'FFFF0000') and is written verbatim as <color rgb=...>; no '#' stripping is done, so '#FF0000' yields an invalid OOXML color.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: | TSV | No | Yes |
findings.quote: | TSV | No | Yes |
